entries.original: game_concept_clerical_title_desc: "$game_concept_clerical_title$是管理[faith|E]内[clerical_region|E]的[clergy|E]持有的[ecclesiastical|E][title|E]。对于[christian|E]信仰，它以[archdiocese|E]的形式出现。\n\n它的持有者是圣职区内[clergy|E]的[religious_superior|E]，通常由[head_of_faith|E]授予。"

game_concept_clerical_region_desc: "圣职区是归属于某一[clerical_title|E]辖区的地理区域。区域内任何神职人员都是该区域相关[title|E]持有者的[subordinate|E]。

一名[ruler|E]属于包含其[capital|E][county|E]的圣职区，而新圣职区会在其建立者[primary_title|E]的[capital|E]建立。圣职区可以覆盖多个[realms|E]，并拥有位于不同领地的下属。

一名$game_concept_ruler$同一时间只能持有一个$game_concept_clerical_region$。若被授予新的区域，该统治者将失去其在前一个区域内持有的所有土地。"

game_concept_archdiocese_desc: "总主教区是[christian|E]下的[clerical_region|E]形式——一种由[archbishop|E]通过其[clerical_title|E]持有的教会领地，以首府[county|E]为驻地，并可在该地可修建[grand_cathedral|E]。\n\n[christian|E][ruler|E]在属灵事务上须听命于其[capital|E][county|E]所属总主教区的[archbishop|E]，而所有总主教区所辖领土共同构成了[the_christian_church|E][situation|E]。"

game_concept_enshrined_desc: "供奉于[holy_site|E]的[holy_relic|E]能激活并提高圣地给予的增益，效果取决于所有供奉的宝物的总[rarity|E]。

供奉的宝物不再由角色拥有，但可以由圣地的[holder|E]、[top_liege|E]或[clerical_region|E]持有者与其互动。宝物将不再破损。你只能供奉自己[faith|E]的圣物，其他信仰的圣物不提供增益。

供奉或移除供奉的宝物可能会有奖励或消耗。"

game_concept_clerical_title_desc: "A $game_concept_clerical_title$ is an [ecclesiastical|E] [title|E] of the [clergy|E] governing a [clerical_region|E] within a [faith|E]. Among the [christian|E] faiths this is an [archdiocese|E].\n\nThe holder is the [religious_superior|E] of the [clergy|E] in that region, and is usually appointed by the [head_of_faith|E]."

game_concept_clerical_region_desc: "A Clerical Region is a geographical region that falls under the jurisdiction of a [clerical_title|E]. Any member of the clergy within the region will be a [subordinate|E] to the holder of the [title|E] associated with the region.

A [ruler|E] belongs to the Clerical Region that contains their [capital|E] [county|E], and a new region is founded upon the [capital|E] of its founder's [primary_title|E]. The region may cover multiple [realms|E] and have subordinates that are in different realms.

A $game_concept_ruler$ may only hold one $game_concept_clerical_region$ at a time. If granted a new Region, the Ruler forfeits all their held land within the previous one."

game_concept_archdiocese_desc: "An Archdiocese is the [christian|E] form of a [clerical_region|E], an ecclesiastical domain held by an [archbishop|E] through its [clerical_title|E] and seated in a capital [county|E], where a [grand_cathedral|E] may be raised.\n\nA [christian|E] [ruler|E] answers in spiritual matters to the [archbishop|E] of the Archdiocese that contains their [capital|E] [county|E], and the territory subject to Archdioceses collectively constitutes [the_christian_church|E] [situation|E]."

game_concept_enshrined_desc: "An enshrined [holy_relic|E] at a [holy_site|E] activates holy site bonuses and improves the bonuses it grants, scaled by the total [rarity|E] levels of all enshrined artifacts.

An enshrined artifact is no longer owned by a character, but may be interacted with by the [holder|E], [top_liege|E], or [clerical_region|E] holder of the holy site. The artifact will no longer decay. You can enshrine only holy relics for your own [faith|E]; enshrined holy relics of other faiths will provide no benefits.

There may be rewards or costs associated with enshrining or removing an enshrined artifact."
谁有这个管理资格？原版规则列了三个身份：圣地所在伯爵领的持有者，这个伯爵领持有者的最高领主，以及这个地方所属教务辖区头衔的持有者。只做中间一层领主，或者只是全教信仰领袖，并不会凭这个身份自动获得这里的权限；还要看他是否同时符合上面三个地方身份之一。
| 地域规则 | 伯爵领持有者、伯爵领持有者最高领主、教务辖区头衔持有者三者 OR | 相同三者 OR |

findings.third_management_identity: Official enshrined_desc explicitly lists holder, top_liege and clerical_region holder; clerical_region_desc links the region to the holder of its associated clerical title. This supports the existing doc third identity without new reverse engineering.
findings.christian_boundary: Archdiocese is specifically the Christian form of a Clerical Region. Do not replace the generic third identity with Archbishop, Diocese or Archdiocese for every faith.
findings.author_phrase: 教务辖区 is an explanatory wording in the existing Chinese management doc, rather than the official clerical_region label 圣职区. No full combined role label is quoted as an official single key.

recommended_subtitle.en: the holder of the clerical title governing this area
recommended_subtitle.zh_reference: 这个地方所属圣职区的头衔持有者
recommended_subtitle.status: composed explanatory wording using official concept terms; not a verbatim official single-key label; no frozen cue edits

findings.short_alternative_en: the holder of this area’s Clerical Region
findings.stance_boundary: Zealot and Minority are vassal stance names. Do not replace Zealot with the zealous personality-trait label; Minority officially corresponds to 少数族群 rather than an invented 少数派 label.
